name: Hasshub
title: Levite Who Sealed the Covenant
summary: Hasshub was one of the leaders in Judah who took part in rebuilding Jerusalem after the exile in Babylon. He is mentioned among those who sealed the covenant with God under Nehemiah and participated in the dedication of Jerusalem's wall. He represents the faithful people who renewed their commitment to God's law after returning from exile.

keyEvents.title: The Procession at the Wall
keyEvents.description: Hasshub took part in the dedication ceremony for Jerusalem's wall and joined one of the two large processions that walked along the top of the wall.

keyEvents.title: The People Renew Their Covenant
keyEvents.description: Hasshub was among the leaders who sealed the covenant and committed themselves to follow God's law under Nehemiah's leadership.

keyEvents.title: Rebuilding Jerusalem
keyEvents.description: In the period after returning from Babylon, Hasshub was part of the community working to rebuild Jerusalem and restore the worship of God.

keyEvents.title: The Reading of the Law
keyEvents.description: As part of the community in rebuilt Jerusalem, Hasshub was among those who heard Ezra read from the Law of Moses and took part in the spiritual renewal.

keyEvents.title: Settlement in Jerusalem
keyEvents.description: Hasaja is mentioned among those who settled in Jerusalem after the return from the Babylonian exile, as one of the leaders of Judah.
